decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are thermoforming materials that build directly on the firm's core dental lab knowledge and in-house R&D, so it can interpret results and refine the line.
A PETG thermoforming blank sits at the heart of the firm's established materials expertise, which makes it easy to assimilate feedback and improve the product.

UV-curing lacquer relates to the firm's materials and digital manufacturing competencies, though it is only mentioned on the website rather than given its own page, which suggests a modest but sustainable role.

Custom hearing protection earmolds build on the firm's skilled custom earmold manufacturing for hearing-care retailers, so it can learn from early results even though the related earmold line was dropped.
